finding: Identifiers and source concepts are conflated with real-world language identity
resolution: Namespaced source concepts, directional assertions, snapshot-specific semantics and alias index; no automatic equivalence or transitive composition.
remaining_work: No worldwide concept-extension adjudication has been performed.

finding: Uncalibrated confidence and alleged independent corroboration
resolution: Removed confidence rankings and independence claims from public outputs; route provenance and measured/unmeasured reporting replace them.
remaining_work: Held-out linguistic mapping accuracy remains unmeasured.

finding: Conflicts and multiplicity still publish a preferred scalar
resolution: Withhold scalars on conflicting or multivalued observations, including ambiguous upstream ISO routes; retain alternatives.

finding: Ancestor/sibling relationships disguise granularity disagreements
resolution: Catalog level/category remains visible; family scope and related targets cannot resolve identity.
remaining_work: Specific narrower/broader/overlap judgments remain for scoped review.

finding: Parent inheritance copies stage identifiers, types and documentation dates
resolution: Removed inherited identifier, type and date copies; non-etymology-only associations are parent context.

finding: Proto-language, named family and phylogenetic crown are conflated
resolution: Proto/family and P279 associations remain context; no fallback stage identity or crown date.
remaining_work: Reconstructed-stage boundaries require source-specific linguistic evidence.

finding: ISO namespaces, macrolanguages and retirement operations lose distinctions
resolution: Separated ISO namespaces, retained macro/member and retirement history, removed successor identity lookup.

finding: Bookkeeping and non-genealogical categories can enter genetic reasoning
resolution: Bookkeeping/non-genealogical contexts cannot become automatic lookup identity or genetic MRCA; all tips required.
remaining_work: Additional sign/contact genealogies need reviewed graphs, not the broad catalog bucket.

finding: Names, suffixes and token overlaps are promoted to identity
resolution: Names are proposals only; removed suffix inheritance, token/regular-code selection and ancestor fallback; Unicode preserved.

finding: Family guards are fallible classifications, with order-dependent pruning
resolution: Removed family-name pruning and proto family backfill; classification disagreement remains an explicit issue; sorted publication.
remaining_work: Source classifications remain competing catalog assertions.

finding: Overrides are unrestricted, stale and applied after dependent inference
resolution: Overrides require a typed scoped relation, purpose, reviewer, evidence references and current source digest, before index generation.

finding: Source versions and hashes are incomplete or unchecked
resolution: Pinned and verified source manifest, input hashes and Glottolog release; reject stale targeted snapshots or ambiguous release selection.
remaining_work: Legacy upstream revisions remain unknown; bytes are reproducible locally.

finding: Wikidata ranks, qualifiers, references and redirects are lost
resolution: Full-statement fetch capability preserves complete entity evidence; legacy losses explicit; redirects resolved with cycle detection.
remaining_work: Current legacy Wikidata provenance is unavailable, not retroactively repaired; fresh statements require deliberate refresh and review.

finding: Flat CSVs and reverse indexes erase relation, provenance and uncertainty
resolution: CSV preserves structured assertions; typed reverse index includes both schemes and every relation/status.

finding: Publication is non-atomic and advertised determinism is false
resolution: Staged retrieval and source lock; content-addressed catalog bundle and atomic commit pointer; mirrors verified.
remaining_work: Mirrors are individually atomic; consistent readers must use the bundle. Real repeated-build digest comparison also performed.

finding: IE-CoR sample identity is replaced by a preferred catalog stage
resolution: Preserved all IE-CoR sample identities and raw source codes; only unresolved candidate relations; receipt binds all inputs/output.
remaining_work: All 160 sample-to-stage relations remain unadjudicated; 153 have proposals and 7 have no current candidates.

finding: Dating consumers reintroduce identity, status and ancestry assumptions
resolution: Dating loads validated generation, removes type/proto identity transfer, retains sample/article/item subjects and source codes.
remaining_work: Existing migrated chronological claims remain candidates/quarantined, not endorsed through these links.

finding: Wiktionary export lacks a reproducible dump/source receipt
resolution: Fixed exporter paths, atomic outputs and final dump/code/dependency/output receipt; registry validates future receipts.
remaining_work: No original dump supplied; fresh extraction was not run and legacy revision provenance cannot be reconstructed here.

finding: Coverage is mistaken for accuracy; no meaningful regression/evaluation suite
resolution: Added adversarial source/mapping tests, actual data regressions and eight dating integration checks; accuracy explicitly unmeasured.
remaining_work: A separately annotated held-out mapping benchmark and specialist disagreement analysis remain research work.

finding: No explicit resolution/accountability mechanism or outstanding mapping queue
resolution: Every finding has an explicit disposition and named checks; all unresolved/context records have prioritized review entries.
remaining_work: Implementation closure is distinct from completion of per-concept linguistic review.
